solution_summary: Logically uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Delta Lake, Lakeflow, and Unity Catalog to support agentic threat intelligence and narrative-risk analysis. Logically needed to open its intelligence platform to nontechnical users because analyst bottlenecks, Elasticsearch limits, and heavy ETL workloads made large-scale harm detection slow and hard to scale. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, coordinates repeatable workflows with Lakeflow, and runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform. Documents, notes, and knowledge assets are consolidated into Delta Lake; pipeline execution is coordinated with Lakeflow; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic.
